use_cases: Interactive hero section element for SaaS landing pages
Decorative 3D background for media and entertainment websites
Data visualization globe for geographic or global metrics display
Ambient visual element for creative portfolio sites
Engaging product showcase centerpiece for tech companies
ai_summary: An interactive 3D globe/orb component built with Three.js featuring a particle starfield background and custom atmospheric glow shader. The component uses OrbitControls for drag-based rotation and perspective camera for depth. Includes responsive sizing with window dimensions and device pixel ratio optimization. Best suited for hero sections, landing pages, or as a decorative interactive element in SaaS, media, and creative applications.
